# newaitools.online — Full Documentation

> A curated directory of the best AI tools, categories, and practical end-to-end workflows for creators, developers, and small teams.

## About

newaitools.online is an independent AI tools directory. It helps users find, compare, and evaluate AI software across 32 categories. The site features curated tool listings with pricing information, practical multi-step workflow guides, and research-led blog articles with tool reviews and comparisons.

## Site Structure

### Home Page (/)
The home page features:
- Hero section with search call-to-action
- Category preview grid (top 6 categories)
- Popular tools showcase (curated top picks)
- Workflow previews (2 featured workflows)
- Statistics banner
- Blog article previews
- Newsletter signup

### Tools Directory (/tools)
A searchable, filterable directory of all AI tools. Each tool listing includes:
- Tool name and description
- Category classification
- Pricing model (Free, Freemium, Paid, Enterprise)
- Tags for discoverability
- Link to detailed tool page

### Categories (/categories)
Browse AI tools organized into 32 categories:
1. Writing & Text — Write, edit, summarize, and polish content
2. Research & Knowledge — Find answers and explore sources
3. Image & Graphic Design — Generate images, design assets
4. Video — Create, edit, and transform video content
5. Audio & Music — Speech, music, podcasts, audio production
6. Coding & Development — Code assistants, debugging, shipping
7. Website & App Creation — Build websites and apps faster
8. Data & Analytics — Explore datasets, generate insights
9. Productivity — Task management, automation, efficiency
10. Business & Operations — Business workflows and planning
11. Marketing & Advertising — Campaign planning and content
12. Sales & CRM — Customer management and lead tracking
13. Social Media — Content creation and scheduling
14. Education & Learning — Personal learning experiences
15. Presentations & Documents — Decks and document creation
16. Automation & AI Agents — Multi-step workflows and agents
17. Customer Support — Faster customer service
18. E-commerce — Product content and store operations
19. Finance — Financial analysis and reporting
20. Legal — Legal research and document workflows
21. Healthcare — Clinical documentation and healthcare AI
22. HR & Recruitment — Recruiting and people operations
23. IT & DevOps — Infrastructure and technical operations
24. 3D & Game Development — 3D assets and game creation
25. Translation & Localization — Cross-language content adaptation
26. SEO — Search demand research and visibility
27. Meetings & Communication — Conversation capture and notes
28. Personal / Lifestyle — Personal planning and everyday AI
29. Scientific & Academic — Academic research and knowledge
30. Knowledge Management — Document and workspace organization
31. Specialized Industry AI — Focused professional workflows
32. AI Infrastructure / Models / APIs — Foundational AI models

### Workflows (/workflows)
Step-by-step guides showing how AI tools work together:
- Script-to-Video workflow
- Research-to-Article workflow
- Website Creation workflow
- E-commerce Product Launch workflow

Each workflow includes: tool recommendations, step-by-step instructions, handoff points, quality gates, and example outputs.

### Blog (/blog)
Research-led articles covering:
- Tool Reviews — Testing real tasks from start to finish
- Tool Comparisons — Side-by-side evaluations using the same criteria
- Workflow Tutorials — Repeatable processes with screenshots and prompts

### Individual Tool Pages (/tool/[slug])
Detailed pages for each AI tool with:
- Full description and use cases
- Pricing details
- Category context
- Related tools

### Individual Category Pages (/category/[slug])
Filtered views showing all tools in a specific category with search functionality.

### Individual Workflow Pages (/workflow/[slug])
Detailed workflow guides with numbered steps, tool links, examples, outputs, handoffs, and quality gates.

## Technical Details
- Built with React + Vite + TypeScript
- Styled with Tailwind CSS
- Deployed on Vercel
- SPA with client-side routing
- SEO managed via dynamic meta tags and structured data (JSON-LD)
- Sitemaps at /sitemap_index.xml
